content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Leases Gamma Knife radiosurgery equipment per procedure to hospitals; it is equipment services, not property rental."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Provides in-home nursing and therapy services paid by government programs; no property ownership or leasing."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Operates senior living communities and collects resident fees; it is an operator, not a landlord leasing to operators."},{"label":"C4","good":false,"reason":"Installs and maintains building mechanical and electrical systems for owners; a construction and facility services business."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants; a landlord model, but office property rather than senior housing or medical."},{"label":"C6","good":false,"reason":"Provides physician staffing services to hospitals, billed to payers; no real estate ownership or leasing."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases office buildings to corporate tenants; same landlord model but office property, not healthcare facilities."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Owns and leases suburban shopping centers to retailers; a landlord model but retail property, not senior housing or medical."},{"label":"C9","good":false,"reason":"Operates skilled nursing and senior living facilities and home health services; an operator earning patient and government payments."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Manages correctional and detention facilities under government contracts; a government services business."},{"label":"C11","good":false,"reason":"Provides management and advisory services to REITs for a fee; it does not own or lease properties itself."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Operates acute care and behavioral hospitals billing patients and payers; a hospital operator, not a property lessor."}]}
